remarks: Charming Mountain Cabin Retreat in Big Bear City    Discover your own mountain getaway in this darling, turnkey rustic cabin nestled in the peaceful surroundings of Big Bear City. Ideally situated away from the hustle and bustle of town traffic, this inviting retreat offers the perfect blend of mountain charm, modern updates, and convenient access to Big Bear’s most popular attractions. Enjoy being just minutes from the lake, Village, restaurants, and ski slopes, with the Big Bear Convention Center and its famous Oktoberfest celebrations within walking distance.
